wish: someone should make a chess variant where a hidden random piece is the king
spec:
Chess where one random piece on each side is secretly the king, with no check: capture the hidden king to win.
You play white against a computer that looks two moves ahead and guards its own secret king; your crowned piece glows only for you. Tap a piece, then a dot. Pass and play is one tap away.
No check, castling or en passant; pawns promote to queen; the computer does not know which of your pieces is the king.
notes: Plays white against a 2-ply computer by default; pass and play on one device uses the show my king button.
